summary: Capcom's courtroom adventure series, including the Phoenix Wright mainline games, Apollo Justice era, Investigations spin-offs, The Great Ace Attorney duology, and the Professor Layton crossover.

entries.title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney

emulation.notes: Use native Windows. DS emulation is only useful for historical touchscreen behavior.

primary.platform: Windows (2019 Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy)
primary.why: The 2019 Trilogy release includes the DS-added fifth case and presents the first game in the highest-fidelity official HD package on PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy on Windows/Steam with the current official build.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern Trilogy presentation replaces the original handheld look; use DS/GBA only for historical comparison.

entries.title: Professor Layton vs. Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney

emulation.notes: Citra can improve output resolution for a legally dumped copy, but the official platform remains Nintendo 3DS.

primary.why: The crossover remains a Nintendo 3DS-only release, so the original 3DS version is the complete primary route.
primary.how_to_play: Play a legally owned Nintendo 3DS copy; for higher output fidelity, use Citra with a dumped copy where legally permitted.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster. Post-game downloadable episodes depended on 3DS online distribution.
